svg.title: Basis resolution, the adjustment pass and the export projection

g.text: Basis resolution, the adjustment pass and the export projection
receive the bars of one write
parse each bar date at 00:00 UTC, timestamp in Unix seconds
copy served open, high, low, close, volume into the raw columns
take adjusted_close from the bar, else its close
compute adjustment_factor as adjusted_close over close_raw
divide volume_raw by the factor of the known splits
compute factor F per row as the product of ratios of splits strictly after its date
any ratio non-finite or not above zero?
raise AdjustmentRefused for the degenerate ratio
divide open, high, low and close raw by F
multiply volume_raw by F into volume
copy the raw columns into the mains
store the rows through reconcile, append or overwrite
project stored rows into Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Adj Close, Volume
validate the frame and render the report
basis table JDL-053; factor JDL-045, JDL-046;
dividends never applied JDL-050; export JDL-071, JDL-072
